author: corvax-team
name: SSCentral
short: SS Central API and management commands for an SS13 server
description: Serves the HTTP API that BandaStation based SS13 servers expect from SS Central and manages Discord links, whitelist and donate tiers from Discord
install_msg: Set the SSCENTRAL_* environment variables before loading, see README
end_user_data_statement: Stores the link between a BYOND ckey and a Discord user ID, plus whitelist, donate tier and ban records for that ckey
